lines.zh: 长腿在丛林地面上一跨一跳。
lines.en: My long legs stride and hop over jungle ground.

lines.zh: 藤蔓挡路，我低头钻过去。
lines.en: Vines block the way, so I duck beneath them.
I run faster than I look.
My feet kick the fallen leaves about.
I trot along the jungle's edge.

lines.zh: 九格东西在背上晃，我照样跑。
lines.en: Nine slots sway on my back, and I still run.

lines.zh: 树根很滑，我一步跨过去。
lines.en: The roots are slick; I clear them in one step.
I dislike deep woods; they block me too much.

lines.zh: 我踩着蕨叶走，声音很轻。
lines.en: I walk on ferns with light steps.

lines.zh: 一只鹦鹉叫，我回了一声。
lines.en: A parrot calls, and I answer.
Long roads do not tire my legs.

lines.zh: 我踩着树根走，泥水会脏羽毛。
lines.en: I walk on roots; mud would soil my feathers.
The shrubs brush against my breast feathers.
Every so often I stop and listen.

lines.zh: 我迈开长腿，掠过一片蕨丛。
lines.en: I stretch my legs and sweep past a fern patch.

lines.zh: 背上的货轻了，我走得更快。
lines.en: My load is lighter, so I go faster.

lines.zh: 我单脚站着，理我的翅羽。
lines.en: I stand on one leg and preen my wing feathers.

lines.zh: 丛林里太吵，我闭眼歇会。
lines.en: The jungle is loud, so I close my eyes.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子看树冠上的光。
lines.en: I stretch my neck toward light in the canopy.

lines.zh: 我的影子在落叶上很长。
lines.en: My shadow lies long across the fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 有虫子爬过脚边，我不吃。
lines.en: A bug crawls past my feet; I do not eat it.

lines.zh: 我把喙埋进翅羽，听丛林的声音。
lines.en: I tuck my beak into my feathers and listen to the jungle.

lines.zh: 九格的背里还空着大半。
lines.en: Most of my nine slots are still empty.
I shake my tail feathers to shed dust.

lines.zh: 丛林的风一停，虫子就来了。
lines.en: When the jungle wind stops, the bugs come.

lines.zh: 丛林太吵，我把头埋进翅里。
lines.en: The jungle's too loud — I'll tuck my head under a wing.

lines.zh: 我站在树根上，像根木桩。
lines.en: I stand on a root like a wooden post.

lines.zh: 我在等浆果自己掉下来。
lines.en: I wait for berries to fall on their own.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的腿就绷紧了。
lines.en: When you move, my legs tense up.

lines.zh: 我认得玩家，你们总想骑我。
lines.en: I know players; you always want to ride me.
Your eyes are too close to mine.
I will not fight you; I only want to run.
You are not holding berries, are you?
I step back half a pace, just enough to run.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声把叶子踩响了。
lines.en: Your steps are cracking the leaves.
I tilt my head and judge how fast you run.
Do not reach out; my beak is hard.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，也盯着你身后的路。
lines.en: I watch you, and the path behind you.
A handful of feathers is torn away.

lines.zh: 疼得我一条腿抬不起来。
lines.en: The pain keeps one leg from lifting.

lines.zh: 我不叫，怕引来更多麻烦。
lines.en: I stay quiet, lest I bring more trouble.
Twenty points of life drain fast.
I back behind a tree, wings still spread.

lines.zh: 这一下打在腿上，我跑不快了。
lines.en: That hit my leg, and now I run slower.

lines.zh: 我抖抖身子，血滴在叶上。
lines.en: I shake myself; blood drips on the leaves.
Pain helps nothing; find my master first.
My beak remains, so I can still fight.
I remember that smell and will avoid it.

lines.zh: 甜浆果的味道，我隔着树都闻到。
lines.en: I smell sweet berries through the trees.
That melon slice is a glaring red.

lines.zh: 你把浆果放地上，我才过去。
lines.en: Put the berries down, then I will come.

lines.zh: 我往前一步，又退了两步。
lines.en: I step forward once and back away twice.
I trust the food, not the person.

lines.zh: 那几颗浆果够我繁殖吗。
lines.en: Are those berries enough for breeding?
Melon juice is dripping onto the ground.
I stretch my neck, but my feet stay put.
The sweetness makes me forget to run.
Step back two paces and I will eat.
You knocked me into a stumble.
My legs are thin; do not hit me with a shoulder.
A whole patch of feathers is mussed.
I leap aside and leave a print.
Bump me once and I remember your smell.
Twenty points of life is not much either.

lines.zh: 我扑腾着站稳，尾羽折了。
lines.en: I flap to steady myself, tail feather bent.
You are blocking my escape route.
I will not strike back; I run first.
Move aside; I need room to start.

lines.zh: 我叼着一颗甜浆果来求偶。
lines.en: I bring a sweet berry to court you.

lines.zh: 西瓜片摆在地上，就是礼物。
lines.en: A melon slice on the ground is my gift.
We run side by side to see who is faster.
My tail feathers are spread; do not laugh.

lines.zh: 丛林边缘的草地适合筑巢。
lines.en: The grass at the jungle's edge suits a nest.
You must eat first to have strength.
Three laps around the tree will do.
I will not run off while we breed.
The berries must be ripe, not green.

lines.zh: 我啄啄你的翅，算是答应。
lines.en: I tap your wing, and that is my yes.

lines.zh: 我叼起一颗浆果，脖子一仰。
lines.en: I pick up a berry and tip my head back.

lines.zh: 九格里塞得下不少东西。
lines.en: Nine slots can hold a fair amount.
I am taking this melon slice.
My beak cannot grip anything too smooth.

lines.zh: 掉的东西我捡，但不白捡。
lines.en: I pick up dropped things, but not for free.
I nudge it onto my back.
With a full load, I run a little slower.
I will hide this bunch of berries first.
I do not pick up stones; too heavy.
Whatever dropped is mine; run.

lines.zh: 有东西从树上跳下来了。
lines.en: Something just dropped out of the tree.
That shadow does not look like a player.
I stretch my neck to get a clear look.
Four attack points can block one blow.
Who snapped that dry branch over there?
I guard my master, so I cannot run.

lines.zh: 树冠里，我的长腿迈开了。
lines.en: Up in the canopy, my long legs start moving.
I lower myself and fold my wings in.
If that is an ocelot, I am in trouble.

lines.zh: 我听到两声脚步，不是一个人。
lines.en: Two sets of footsteps, not one person.
The target is small; I can try.
When I guard my master I do not flee.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，一条腿先抬起。
lines.en: I fix on it and lift one leg first.

lines.zh: 它比我矮，冲起来不占优。
lines.en: It is shorter than me; charging favors me less.

lines.zh: 我贴着藤蔓滑过去，一声不吭。
lines.en: I slip along the vines without a sound.
My long legs reach it first.

lines.zh: 丛林里送信，我从不迷路。
lines.en: Carrying mail through jungle, I never get lost.
I lower my weight, ready to peck.

lines.zh: 距离还有三步，正好起跳。
lines.en: Three steps out, perfect for a leap.
It watches my beak and dares not move.
I guard my master, but I am not reckless.

lines.zh: 那目标在犹豫，我再等等。
lines.en: The target hesitates; I wait a little longer.
My tail feathers tremble; that is nerves.
One more step toward my master and I go.
I peck, and my beak tip cracks loud.

lines.zh: 长腿一蹬，我撞在它胸口。
lines.en: My long legs kick and I strike its chest.
Four points of beak will hurt it.
It grabs my wing; I peck its eye.

lines.zh: 我跳起来，从上面砸下去。
lines.en: I leap and come down from above.

lines.zh: 打完我就退回主人身边。
lines.en: After the blow I retreat to my master.

lines.zh: 我啄它一下，掉两根羽毛也值。
lines.en: One peck from me is worth two lost feathers.
It backs off, and I do not chase far.
This blow I take in my master's place.
My beak is harder than it looks.

lines.zh: 我从丛林灌木里站起来。
lines.en: I rise out of the jungle shrubs.

lines.zh: 藤蔓间漏下的光正好照我。
lines.en: Light through the vines lands right on me.
I shake out my feathers and call once.

lines.zh: 这是我第一次踩到落叶。
lines.en: This is the first time I tread fallen leaves.

lines.zh: 丛林边缘风大，我站稳了。
lines.en: The jungle edge is windy; I plant my feet.

lines.zh: 九格的背还空着，等装东西。
lines.en: Nine empty slots wait to be filled.

lines.zh: 我打量着这片陌生的绿。
lines.en: I study this unfamiliar green.
A player is far off; I get ready to run.

lines.zh: 我的长腿在这里正合适。
lines.en: My long legs suit this place.
The vines are high; I must look up.
Fire catches my tail feathers and I thrash.

lines.zh: 我从树上摔下，翅没撑住。
lines.en: I fall from the tree; my wings fail.

lines.zh: 水灌进羽毛，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water soaks my feathers and I cannot float.
The blast throws me into the shrubs.
An arrow pierces my wing base; I stagger.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的羽毛竖起来。
lines.en: Magic makes every feather stand on end.
No berries left, and my legs go weak.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的羽毛全亮了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my feathers all light up.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有丛林，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No jungle in the void, only endless falling.
